credits.title: Django Undisputed
credits.overview: Determined to exact his justice, Django faces dangerous challenges and bloody clashes to restore order in a territory dominated by lawlessness and injustice.

His partner Valentina, with whom he is deeply in love, is expecting a child and the young couple's life seems to be going well.
